title.en: HTTP.sys dropped requests for server-side reasons

explanation.fa: در ۶۰ دقیقه گذشته: {iis.httperr.top_server_side} (QueueFull = صف پر، AppOffline = Pool غیرفعال، Connection_Abandoned_By_ReqQueue = Crash/Recycle).
explanation.en: In the last 60 minutes: {iis.httperr.top_server_side} (QueueFull = queue full, AppOffline = pool disabled, Connection_Abandoned_By_ReqQueue = crash/recycle).

recommendation.fa: وضعیت Pool و رخدادهای WAS را در همان زمان بررسی کنید.
recommendation.en: Check the pool state and WAS events at the same time.
